nodes.label: Use Passive Event Listeners for Scrolling Performance
nodes.source_location: ## Use Passive Event Listeners for Scrolling Performance
nodes.rationale: Without `{ passive: true }` the browser must wait for the touch/wheel listener to finish before it knows whether preventDefault() was called, delaying scroll. Use it for tracking and logging; do not use it for custom swipe gestures or zoom controls that genuinely need preventDefault().

edges.source_location: complementary halves of the same addEventListener-in-useEffect concern: how many listeners you register vs how each one is registered
